State and Federal regulations exist to prevent construction activities on wet lands and other lands which are not suitable for development.

Comment: It is recommended that the Commission consider adoption of an additional alternative which would apply a revised population-mileage formula to all cities except those for which it can be demonstrated that application of the formula would include significant large areas which are presently rural and undeveloped, and that development of this land would have severe adverse environmental impacts. (Lakeville.)
Response: This suggestion is embodied in the "no action" alternative.

Comment: Reliance upon population statistics is not a useful tool
for determining a commercial zone formula. (A-C Berwick).

Response: While use of population statistics admittedly does not present an entirely accurate reflection of commercial and industrial activity, it is a reasonable proxy for determining commercial zones.
